title: Rules on Matters Delegated by the Management of the National Funds Act, etc.
title_original: 국고금관리법 등의 위임사항 등에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters concerning the designation of official posts for public officials engaged in accounting and delegation of appointment authority under the Management of the National Funds Act, etc. <Amended 2003.10.24, 2006.11.13, 2006.12.28>

Article 2 Deleted. <2006.12.28>

Article 3 (Designation of Revenue Collection Officers, etc.) The official posts of revenue collection officers, finance officers and disbursing officers under Article 9(1) and (3), Article 21(1) and (2), and Article 22(1) and (2) of the Management of the National Funds Act, and of divided-duty officers and acting officers under Article 40(1), (2) and (3) of that Act, are designated as set out in Annex 1. <Amended 2003.10.24, 2006.11.13>
[Wholly amended 1994.1.31]
[Title amended 2003.10.24]

Article 4 (Delegation of Authority to Appoint Acting Divided-Duty Revenue Collection Officers, etc.) Among the posts designated under Article 3, authority to appoint acting divided-duty revenue collection officers and acting divided-duty finance officers of branch courts without judges is delegated to the chief of the court to which the branch belongs. <Amended 2003.10.24>
[Title amended 2003.10.24]

Article 5 (Delegation of Authority to Appoint Cashiers) Authority to appoint cashiers under Article 4-3 of the Management of the National Funds Act and divided-duty officers and acting officers under Article 40(2) and (3) of that Act is delegated to the respective heads of the institutions to which they belong, as set out in Annex 2.
[Wholly amended 2015.12.29]

Article 3 (Relationship with Other Statutes and Regulations) Where other statutes or regulations cite the Rules on Matters Delegated by the Budget and Accounts Act, etc. or provisions of those Rules as at the time these Rules enter into force, and these Rules contain corresponding provisions, the citations are deemed to refer to these Rules or their corresponding provisions in place of the former provisions.
